subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings expose, hide, or neutralize existence metadata for transcript-mentioned files and directories outside the fs-safe workspace root?
rationale: The current issue asks to avoid false Missing badges, but the open linked PR showed that one implementation path can expose outside-root filesystem metadata; automation should not choose that boundary policy.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the user-facing rail avoids red Missing badges without raw outside-root stat calls.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The Gateway may return existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths, but only with explicit maintainer acceptance and tests documenting the boundary.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend Semantics
options.body: Land only remaining rail layout fixes separately while deciding external-path list semantics in a narrower Gateway item.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the user-facing rail avoids red Missing badges without raw outside-root stat calls.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file preview work makes this the strongest available owner for the fs-safe boundary decision.
